summary: Produced design artefacts for all four stage-16 requirements: DDL-04 (Idempotent batched backfill), OBP-04 (Outbox gate hysteresis and escalation), ORD-03 (Sequence order guard and gap sweeping), VLD-04 (Validation gate at authoring and promotion). Classification per lego-catalog: DDL-04 = Type C (plat_migration_state) + Type E (src/platform/backfill.zig); OBP-04 = Type C (plat_outbox_gate) + Type E (src/outbox/gate.zig); ORD-03 = Type E only (schema already exists; DLQ item_type is code-only); VLD-04 = Type C (process_definitions verdict columns) + Type E (src/validation/gate.zig). All 4 Type E designs pass tools/lint_design_artefact.py (exit 0); all 3 Type C YAMLs pass lint + tools/codegen_migration.py --dry-run (exit 0). Every acceptance criterion of each requirement is addressed via an explicit AC-coverage table in each design. Requirement statuses advanced to IN_PROGRESS (closest legal reqctl status; DESIGNED is not in reqctl VALID_STATUSES though AGENT_SYSTEM.md names it in the lifecycle - flagged MINOR).

issues_found.description: Handoff acceptance criterion #5 asks to set requirement status to DESIGNED via tools/reqctl.py set-status, but DESIGNED is not in reqctl.py VALID_STATUSES (DRAFT/VALIDATED/PENDING/IN_PROGRESS/IMPLEMENTED/TESTED/RELEASED/UNTRACKED/INFORMATIONAL/DEPRECATED) even though docs/agents/AGENT_SYSTEM.md and fn-update-requirement-status.md name DESIGNED in the canonical lifecycle. set-status ... DESIGNED hard-fails (exit 1). Used IN_PROGRESS as the closest legal status with an explanatory note for all four IDs (DDL-04/OBP-04/ORD-03/VLD-04). Recommend adding DESIGNED to reqctl.py VALID_STATUSES or amending the acceptance criterion.

VLD-04: DEFINITION_VALIDATED / DEFINITION_VALIDATION_FAILED event types are not seeded in event_type_registry (migration 1152 seeds only EXECUTION_*); the Type C migration adds the verdict columns but BACKEND-DEV must seed the two event types (CUSTOM edit following 1152 pattern) before src/validation/gate.zig persistVerdict appends pass the ES-05 registry check. See src/design/vld-04-validation-gate-authoring-promotion.md Open questions #1.

OBP-01/02/03 (outbox depth counter, ingress refusal, OutboxOverflow emit) are not yet implemented; OBP-04 designs the gate interface they will call (evaluateAndDecide/recordRefusal) so later handoffs do not change signatures. AC5's drainer restart is an operator/infra hook. See src/design/obp-04-outbox-gate-hysteresis-escalation.md Open questions.
